description_text: About the team SumUp is best known for helping small businesses get paid our Consumer tribe builds the other half of that story. Identify opportunities to improve conversion customer value and sustainable growth using funnel analysis cohort analysis segmentation and behavioural analytics. Collaborate closely with Product Managers Designers Engineers and Data teams to ensure decisions are grounded in robust analysis customer insight and commercial understanding. Evaluate the performance of customer segments markets channels and product journeys helping the team understand where growth opportunities and commercial trade-offs exist. Support decisions that improve key business outcomes such as activation conversion repeat usage retention churn customer lifetime value and revenue-related metrics. Conduct exploratory analysis to answer product and business questions translating complex data into clear commercially relevant recommendations. Build and maintain dashboards and reporting that stakeholders actively use proactively surfacing trends anomalies performance risks and growth opportunities. You re comfortable assessing trade-offs challenging assumptions and making recommendations based on evidence.
